verificationChecks.name: POSIX shell data and argument boundary
verificationChecks.basis: The private PID path is single-quoted, with every embedded apostrophe escaped by closing/reopening the quoted string. Fixed /bin/sh, builtin printf, absolute /bin/sleep and literal 60 require no external data as command text or PATH resolution.

verificationChecks.name: Original total-setup deadline and owned custody
verificationChecks.basis: The original 400 ms launch budget and strict elapsed less than 1000 ms remain; a monotonic minimum elapsed assertion rejects unrelated early launch failure. Exactly one actual durable owner must be closed for the captured root, the private wrapper directory must be gone, and owned-session state must be absent. If the target recorded a PID, that positive safe-integer PID must be dead. Target absence is explicitly not protocol-stall proof in this distinct setup test.

verificationChecks.name: Confirmed protocol stall and parent deadline
verificationChecks.basis: The real shell writes $$ before exec of sleep, preserving that PID and the inherited owned wrapper process group without a protocol handshake. Readiness is limited to 1500 ms and races real launch failure; it must yield a positive safe-integer PID that is alive with launch still pending. Only then is the 400 ms parent signal armed; rejection, actual signal abortion, strict cancellation elapsed less than 1000 ms, PID death and owned-session absence are required. Overall launch admission is finite at 2500 ms and both test caps remain 5000 ms.

verificationChecks.name: Finalizer coordination and failure propagation
verificationChecks.basis: The actual launch promise is captured outside the task. Finally clears the timer, aborts the parent, and awaits that launch settlement before restoring environment, closing the captured root or removing files. This prevents duplicate no-server disposal and late cleanup after root removal. Catching the expected launch cancellation only in finalization does not turn the original readiness/assertion error into success.

verificationChecks.name: Bun TypeScript parsing
verificationChecks.basis: The actual current complete file passed Bun.Transpiler TypeScript parsing without executing test source; this is not strict type-check evidence.
